panels.title: Cluster healthy
panels.description: OK when every partition has all of its nodes available (fully redundant); KO if any partition is degraded.

panels.title: Cluster available
panels.description: OK when every partition still has a quorum of nodes, so reads and writes succeed; KO otherwise.

panels.title: Replication factor
panels.description: Configured number of replicas per partition.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: Running Garage version, read from the `version` label of garage_build_info.

panels.title: Partition health over time
panels.description: Watch quorum/all-ok dip below total during rebalancing or node loss.

panels.title: Disk usage %
panels.description: Fill level of the data and metadata volumes per node.

panels.title: Local disk available vs total
panels.description: data and metadata volumes reported separately.

panels.title: Table size (objects per table)
panels.description: Number of items stored in each metadata table.

panels.title: Block reference-counter size
panels.description: Number of data blocks tracked by the reference counter.

panels.title: Merkle tree size
panels.description: Anti-entropy Merkle tree node count per table.

panels.title: S3 error rate by status code
Resync queue length
panels.description: Blocks pending re-sync to satisfy replication. Should trend to 0.

panels.title: Resync errored blocks
panels.description: Blocks that repeatedly failed to re-sync.

panels.title: Compression level
panels.description: Configured zstd compression level for stored blocks.

panels.title: Table GET / PUT rate by table
Table queue lengths
panels.description: Sustained growth indicates the node cannot keep up with writes/anti-entropy.

panels.title: Layout: node connectivity
panels.description: 1 = each node in the cluster layout is currently connected. Drops to 0 when a peer is unreachable.

panels.title: Layout: time since last disconnect
panels.description: Seconds a layout node has been disconnected (0 while connected).
